(GIRISH CHATNI)
XXIX ACJM, BENGALURU  JUDGMENT
The P.I., of Kothanuru Police Station, Bengaluru, has filed the present charge sheet against the accused for the offence punishable under sections Secs.498A, 504, 506 of IPC.

2. BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :
It is the case of the complainant that, she got love marriage with accused in Register Office and resided with C.C.No.74367/2024 accused at No.251, 7th Cross, BDS Nagar, K.Narayanapura, Kothanuru.
It is further alleged that, after marriage there was a small issues in their marital life, due to which, accused abused CW.1 in filthy language and threatened her with dire consequences.
Based on the private complaint filed by the CW.1, this court referred the matter to the jurisdictional police station to register the case.

Accordingly, CW.08 has registered the case against accused in P.S.
Crime No.277/2024 for the offence punishable under sections 341, 498A, 448,
506(B) of IPC and Secs.3 and 4 of D.P.Act.

Investigating Officers/ CW.08 and CW.09 investigated the matter, after completion of the investigation, CW.09 has submitted final report against the accused for the offence punishable U/s 498A, 506 and 504 of IPC.
3.
Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the alleged offence against the accused and registered the criminal case against him.
Accused appeared before this court and was enlarged on bail.
Copy of the final report and it's enclosures were furnished to him in compliance of section 207 of Cr.P.C.
Sufficient grounds were made out to frame charges.
Hence, charges framed and read over to the accused.
He pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

In order to prove the guilt of the accused, the prosecution has examined one witness out of 09 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as P.W.1 and relied upon documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.06 and closed its side.

In lieu of absence of incriminating circumstances appearing against accused,
recording of his statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
5. Heard both sides.
Perused the materials on record.

sentences.text: 1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that the accused was married with CW.1 in Register office, after marriage there was a small issues between them and accused has subjected CW.1 to cruelty by harassing her mentally and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.498A of IPC ?
2. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused has abused CW.1 in filthy language and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.504 of IPC ?
Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused has threatened CW.1 with dire consequences and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.506 of IPC ?
4. What Order?

7. My findings on the above points are as under:
Point Nos.1 to 3 : In the Negative.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution has examined the complainant/victim/C.W.1 as P.W.1 and relied upon six documents.

9. In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution has examined the complainant /
victim CW.1 as PW.1, wherein, the said witness has not supported the case of C.C.No.74367/2024 the prosecution.

The learned APP appearing for the State with permission treated the said witness as hostile and fully cross examined her, wherein, nothing has been elicited from the mouth of the PW.1 in order to prove the guilt of the accused.
10. On perusal of the materials on record and the oral & documentary evidence of P.W.1, she has categorically admitted that, she has compromised the matter with the accused.

In view of the evidence of P.W.1, since the matter was compromised, the prayer of the learned Senior Asst. Public Prosecutor for issuance of witness summons to other witnesses was rejected as no purpose would be served.
As the P.W.1 has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution, the evidence on record is not at all helpful to substantiate the guilt of the accused.
Hence, there is no cogent and convincing evidence against the accused.
Accordingly, the benefit of doubt has to be extended to the accused and hence, the Point Nos.1 to 3 are answered in the "Negative".

sentences.text: Point No.4 :- In view of the findings on above points, I proceed to pass the following;
ORDER Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused is acquitted of the C.C.No.74367/2024 offence punishable under Secs.498A, 504, 506 of IPC.
The Bail bond and surety bond of the accused shall be in force for the period of 6 months and thereafter it shall be cancelled without further orders.
